description: VOL-99 performance budgets. `scripts/check_performance.sh` reads this file after the perf suite runs and compares each metric's measured mean against the `budget` field. A mean that exceeds `failThreshold` breaks the build. Units are documented per-metric; do not change them without updating the parser.

metrics.budgetSource: VOL-99 first-tag baseline (2026-05-04, run #25300372157): 5 iterations measured 3.13 / 3.15 / 3.15 / 3.17 / 3.62s, mean 3.245s on M4 mac mini self-hosted runner. Budget = mean + ~25% headroom; failThreshold = mean + ~55%. The 3.62s outlier is the truly-cold first iteration; subsequent iterations are warm-cold (sim already running but app re-launched) and cluster tightly.
metrics.description: Cold-launch wall-clock time. Measured with XCTApplicationLaunchMetric, which tears down the app and re-launches on each iteration. The realistic floor on a fresh sim with Sentry / SwiftData / CloudKit init is ~3s — the original 1.2s budget was theoretical and never validated against real CI hardware.

metrics.budgetSource: VOL-99 first-tag baseline (2026-05-04, run #25300372157): 5 iterations measured 2.37 / 2.37 / 2.38 / 2.38 / 2.40s, mean 2.380s. Budget = mean + ~5%; failThreshold = mean + ~26%.
metrics.description: Wall-clock duration of one scroll iteration (5 swipes up + 5 swipes down on the seeded Today list of 50 rows). Measured by XCTOSSignpostMetric.scrollingAndDecelerationMetric, which despite the name emits a per-iteration **duration** in seconds — NOT a hitch ratio. A regression in scroll smoothness shows up as a longer iteration duration because XCUITest's swipe gesture waits for the scroll to settle before returning. Direct duration is a more honest budget than the previous frame_rate / hitches_per_second derivations, which assumed a hitch-ratio metric type that this OSSignpost doesn't actually emit. Future improvement: switch to a true hitch-ratio metric (XCTOSSignpostMetric.scrollDecelerationHitchTimeRatioMetric, available iOS 14+) for direct fps signal.

metrics.budgetSource: VOL-99 Linear acceptance criteria. Validated against first-tag baseline (2026-05-04, run #25300372157): peak 68.8MB, well under the 150MB budget. The metric stem must include `_absolute` — the bare `.physical` metric is a per-iteration delta (often negative) and is not what 'memory footprint' means.
metrics.description: Mean absolute physical memory footprint over a 45-second synthetic workout iteration. `physical_absolute` is the resident-set value at iteration end; `physical` (without `_absolute`) is the iteration delta and is unsuitable for a footprint budget.

P50 wall-clock time from the Ask Coach tap to the first coach bubble reaching non-empty content. Computed by XCTClockMetric. VOL-162 root-caused the prior 10-second waitForExistence ceiling: in PerfTestMode the factory was installing FoundationModelCoachProvider, which has limited simulator support and never streamed. Fixed in `VolumeArcAIRuntimeFactory.makeCoachProvider` by short-circuiting to `LocalHeuristicAICoachProvider` whenever `VolumeArcRuntimeFlags.isPerformanceTestMode` is true.
P95 wall-clock time from the Ask Coach tap to the first coach bubble reaching non-empty content. See coach_first_token_p50 for the VOL-162 root cause + fix.

metrics.budgetSource: VOL-215 Phase 1 starter floor (2026-05-18). Conservative pre-first-archive value; the first tag build will capture the real baseline and a follow-up PR will ratchet these numbers down. The 80/100 budget assumes a typical mid-size iOS app with Sentry + Gemini SDKs and an embedded watch app + watch widget extension. Reference: Apple's TestFlight over-the-air download cap is ~150MB (apps larger than that require Wi-Fi). Same ratchet contract as VOL-205 coverage gates.
metrics.description: Total IPA archive size on disk after `xcodebuild -exportArchive`. Measured by `scripts/check_ipa_size.sh`; intended to run tag-gated alongside the existing perf-budget gate.

metrics.budgetSource: VOL-215 Phase 1 starter floor (2026-05-18). The iPhone .app bundle inside the IPA's Payload directory, excluding the embedded watch app and extensions. Pre-first-archive estimate; ratchet down once we have a real measurement.
metrics.description: Size on disk of `Payload/VolumeArc.app` (top-level iPhone app, excluding the embedded watch app and extensions).

metrics.budgetSource: VOL-215 Phase 1 starter floor (2026-05-18). Embedded watchOS app under `VolumeArc.app/Watch/VolumeArcWatch.app`. Pre-first-archive estimate; ratchet down once measured.
metrics.description: Size on disk of the embedded `VolumeArcWatch.app` (watchOS payload). Independent of the widget extension.

metrics.budgetSource: VOL-215 Phase 1 starter floor (2026-05-18). The watch widget extension (`VolumeArcWatchWidgets.appex`) is a small WidgetKit extension; 5MB is generous for the current size. Ratchet down once measured.
metrics.description: Size on disk of the `VolumeArcWatchWidgets.appex` extension inside the watch app's `PlugIns/` directory.
